final: WITH type_rates AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM type_rates) SELECT tr.Name, tr.rate, tr.track_count, tr.rate - o.avg_rate AS above_average FROM type_rates tr CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE tr.rate > o.avg_rate
